issues.where: crops M and R, the right and lower solar limb
issues.what: Fine photospheric granulation gives way to a broad, nearly smooth yellow band just inside the silhouette. The bright contour and softer corona outside it make the band read like a separate shell.
issues.fix: Carry fine granulation into the limb with a gradual loss of contrast and blend the photosphere and corona without reinforcing the same contour twice.

issues.where: crop A, the upper rim of the blue planet
issues.what: A narrow white-cyan outline sits inside a broader blue halo, giving the sunlit rim a neon, layered look.
issues.fix: Reduce the peak white-cyan intensity and let the atmosphere taper continuously from the lit edge into space.

issues.where: crops A and F, the brightest isolated star in their overlap
issues.what: One bright star is a large, soft circular blob with no distinct point-like core, unlike nearby stars.
issues.fix: Keep a compact bright core and reduce the width and opacity of its bloom.

issues.where: crop H (and L), lower right of the asteroid where the lit side meets the shadow
issues.what: the surface texture is stretched into long smeared streaks running along the slope, like a texture projected at a grazing angle. It does not hold up at native size
issues.fix: use triplanar or curvature-aware projection on steep faces, or add displacement and texture density so the detail does not stretch at grazing angles

issues.where: crop C, H and L, shadowed half of the asteroid
issues.what: the night side is filled with a strong flat blue-grey ambient light, so the shadow reads as an evenly lit plastic surface instead of deep shadow. Craters on that side have almost no shading
issues.fix: cut the ambient and sky fill on the asteroid sharply, make the shadow side close to black, and keep only a faint bounce

issues.where: asteroid terminator, diagonal across the body
issues.what: the line between light and shadow is a hard, ragged, noisy band where single texture flecks switch from lit to dark. It looks like a mask cut, not light falling off over relief
issues.fix: drive the terminator from real normals and displacement with a soft-shadow light source, and filter the albedo so specks do not flicker across the boundary

issues.where: sky in every crop, most visible in B, C and K
issues.what: a faint regular lattice of dim pixels sits in the black background. At native size it reads as a screen-door grid or a dither pattern
issues.fix: remove the ordered dither and tiled noise from the sky and use blue-noise dither or none

issues.what: the outline is slightly stair-stepped with some single-pixel aliasing on the lit edge
issues.fix: raise the anti-aliasing samples on the asteroid edge

issues.where: star field, crops S to W
issues.what: the brightest stars are small square blobs a few pixels wide with a soft halo, and the faint stars are all much the same single pixel. The field looks procedurally even
issues.fix: render stars as point-spread sprites with a proper brightness range, and add slight clustering or a faint galactic gradient
